verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Glama serves an llms.txt at glama.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its directory. That llms.txt advertises an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec "for generating a client", and an RFC 9727 /.well-known/api-catalog links the machine spec and hosted reference, so an agent has a machine-discoverable path from a well-known URL. missing for 10: markdown versions of doc pages (the /mcp.md probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://glama.ai/llms.txt # Glama
advertised from its llms.txt "for generating a client" and discoverable through an RFC 9727 API catalog at /.well-known/api-catalog whose service-desc points at the spec
completing a fully machine-discoverable chain from the well-known path
